card.name: Lung toxicity lists in warnings
card.fires_on: The word pulmonary (or a joining comma, slash or 'and') inside lists of lung adverse reactions such as pneumonitis and fibrosis, in warnings sections. Also fires on joiners in other serious-risk lists.

modes.label: Pulmonary in lung-toxicity list
modes.description: The word pulmonary after pneumonitis, just before fibrosis in a pulmonary toxicity warning.
modes.example: Pulmonary Toxicity Pneumonitis,<< pulmonary>> fibrosis, pulmonary veno-oc

modes.label: Joiner in lung disease heading
modes.description: A slash or 'and' linking interstitial lung disease with pneumonitis.
modes.example: Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)<< and>> Pneumonitis: DATROW

modes.label: Joiner in serious-risk list
modes.description: A comma or 'of' leading into death or cardiovascular outcomes in boxed warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: ESAs INCREASE THE RISK<< OF>> DEATH, MYOCARDIAL INF
